description.raw: '''Innate:''' '''Jax's''' [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] generate a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] of ''Relentless Assault'' [[File:On-attack icon.svg|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Attacking|An icon representing the keyword On-attack]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Attacking|on-attack]] for 2.5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 8 times. Stacks expire one by one every 0.25 seconds when the duration ends.
description.text: Innate: Jax's basic attacks generate a stack of Relentless Assault on-attack for 2.5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 8 times. Stacks expire one by one every 0.25 seconds when the duration ends.

description2.raw: '''Relentless Assault:''' For each stack, '''Jax''' gains [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] 5% – 12.5% (based on level)[[Category:Debug]] '''bonus''' attack speed, up to a maximum of 40% – 100% (based on level)[[Category:Debug]].
description2.text: Relentless Assault: For each stack, Jax gains  5% – 12.5% (based on level)Category:Debug bonus attack speed, up to a maximum of 40% – 100% (based on level)Category:Debug.

description3.raw: '''Grandmaster at Angling:''' While out-of-combat with champions and idle in the river for 10 seconds, '''Jax''' will occasionally catch a fish, granting him [[File:Gold colored icon.svg|20xpx|link=Gold|An icon representing Gold]] 1 and 1 ability power for 5 seconds. He catches a fish at an average rate of one every 15 seconds. He also has a 5% chance to catch a [[File:Jax Grandmaster at Angling 2.png|link=|20 px]] rare fish that grants [[File:Gold colored icon.svg|20xpx|link=Gold|An icon representing Gold]] 10 and 10 ability power for 5 seconds.
description3.text: Grandmaster at Angling: While out-of-combat with champions and idle in the river for 10 seconds, Jax will occasionally catch a fish, granting him 1 and 1 ability power for 5 seconds. He catches a fish at an average rate of one every 15 seconds. He also has a 5% chance to catch a rare fish that grants 10 and 10 ability power for 5 seconds.

notes.raw: * '''Jax''' will start fishing while idle in the river if he is in-combat with only monsters (e.g. Epic monsters).(bug) * '''Jax''' catching a fish is a random event and will play a special animation. * The total number of fish caught during the game is displayed when fishing as [[File:Grandmaster at Angling.png|20xpx|border|link=Jax#Relentless Assault|An icon for Jax's ability Relentless Assault]] [[Jax#Relentless Assault|Grandmaster at Angling]] passive. * ''Relentless Assault'' uses its [[File:Jax Relentless Assault old2.png|link=|20 px]] old icon in the [[Death Recap]].
notes.text:
Jax will start fishing while idle in the river if he is in-combat with only monsters (e.g. Epic monsters).(bug)
Jax catching a fish is a random event and will play a special animation.
The total number of fish caught during the game is displayed when fishing as Grandmaster at Angling passive.
Relentless Assault uses its old icon in the Death Recap.
